title: The consumer's best bundle
caption: The budget line 2x + 5y = 100 is tangent to the indifference curve xy = 250 at (25, 10): half of income, £50, goes on each good.
alt: A downward budget line touching a curved indifference curve at the point (25, 10).
description: Cobb–Douglas spends half of income on each good: x = 50/2 = 25, y = 50/5 = 10.
The line touches the curve xy = 250 at that point (equal slopes).
